assistworld-assist-world:lever:9788f89c-.title: Executive Assistant - Billing
assistworld-assist-world:lever:9788f89c-.description: Role Overview We are hiring a full-time Executive Assistant to support Partners at a high-standards, white-glove professional services firm operating in private credit / debt brokerage for high-growth companies. This role is Executive Assistant–first (not social media). You will act as a central execution and coordination point across communications, scheduling, materials preparation, CRM upkeep and partner task tracking. Accuracy, responsiveness and judgment are critical this is a client-facing environment with no margin for careless errors. The firm leverages automation and AI-native workflows, but this role exists to ensure a human, high-touch experience for clients, lenders, and partners. Core Responsibilities Client & Lender Correspondence (High Priority) ● Manage inbound and outbound communication across WhatsApp, email, and Slack ● Draft clear, professional messages on behalf of Partners ● Track ongoing threads and ensure timely follow-ups ● Maintain a polished, white-glove tone across all external communications ● Escalate time-sensitive or high-risk items appropriately Calendar & Scheduling Management (High Priority) ● Own end-to-end scheduling for meetings and calls with clients, lenders, and internal partners ● Coordinate across time zones, manage reschedules, and send confirmations/reminders ● Ensure calendars are clean, current, and prioritized ● Prepare Partners in advance with agendas, links, and required materials Meeting Materials, Pitch Materials & Presentations (High Priority) ● Prepare and refine meeting decks, pitch materials, and presentation documents ● Build professional, executive-level slides for: ○ Client presentations ○ Lender discussions ○ Board / internal strategy meetings ● Work in PowerPoint, Google Slides and/or Canva (must export cleanly to PowerPoint) ● Ensure consistency in formatting, charts, tables, and narrative flow CRM Updates & Pipeline Hygiene (High Priority) ● Keep CRM records accurate and up to date (contacts, notes, activities, follow-ups) ● Log communication and meeting outcomes where required ● Support light pipeline tracking so nothing falls through the cracks Partner Task Tracking & Weekly Execution (High Priority) ● Track Partners’ weekly to-dos and priorities ● Maintain a clear task system with owners and deadlines ● Convert meeting outcomes into actionable next steps ● Proactively follow up to keep work moving and reduce Partner bottlenecks Working Style Expectations ● White-glove execution: precise, polished, client-ready work at all times ● High ownership: anticipates needs and follows through without being chased ● Detail-oriented: errors in comms, decks or scheduling are not acceptable ● Process-minded: comfortable working alongside automation and improving workflows ● Confidential & discreet: trusted with sensitive financial and client information

farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:eb3b2a11-87.title: Customer Service Advisor (French Speaker)
farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:eb3b2a11-87.description: Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. OPERATIONS The Operations team serves as the backbone of our marketplace, seamlessly managing the entire order journey. From creating online content and ensuring secure payments to order fulfillment and delivery, while providing comprehensive customer and partner care, this team is relentlessly focused on improving the customer experience every single day. PORTO Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals. THE ROLE We are looking for a Customer Service Advisor (French Speaker), to work in a very and relaxed environment and be part of a well-motivated, and growing team. Reporting to the Customer Service Supervisor, you will gain excellent experience, which will broaden as the team grows. You will have main responsibility to ensure that the highest levels of customer service are delivered to both our consumers and partners and through every communication channel.
responsibilities: Respond to Customer Inquiries through several channels (Chat, Email and Telephone);
Provide information with regards to products and services and other related inquiries;
Be the face of Farfetch to our customers and partners alike.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7f15b19d-5c3a-.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:7f15b19d-5c3a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer based in India. This is a senior engineering opportunity focused on building secure, scalable, and reliable capabilities for enterprise SaaS platforms. You will take ownership of significant technical initiatives across software design, development, testing, and production support. The role combines hands-on engineering with architectural thinking and close collaboration across product, QA, UX, and operations teams. You will work with C# and .NET while engaging with functional programming, system-level APIs, networking protocols, distributed systems, and cross-platform development. The position also encourages the practical use of AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and code quality. You will contribute to technical standards, mentor other engineers, and help drive continuous improvements across the development lifecycle. Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software features for enterprise SaaS platforms and related product capabilities. Build scalable services, APIs, platform components, integrations, and customer-facing functionality with a focus on reliability and performance. Contribute to technical architecture, design decisions, code reviews, troubleshooting, and production support. Collaborate with product management, QA, UX/UI, operations, and engineering teams to deliver roadmap commitments effectively. Improve software performance, reliability, security, maintainability, automation, and observability across the technology stack. Follow and contribute to the evolution of Agile development, CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps practices. Apply AI-assisted coding tools for code generation, analysis, reviews, and other software development activities. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through technical guidance, constructive code reviews, and knowledge sharing. Clearly communicate project progress, technical risks, blockers, and architectural trade-offs to stakeholders. Work within a hybrid setup requiring onsite presence at the Pune office three days per week. Requirements At least 4 years of professional experience working with C# and the .NET ecosystem. Experience with functional programming using F#, or a strong willingness and ability to learn it. Very good knowledge of Win32 APIs and system-level development concepts. Strong understanding of networking protocols, including HTTP, TLS, and WebSockets. Experience working with different inter-process communication (IPC) mechanisms. Strong software engineering fundamentals, with a focus on writing clean, maintainable, and testable code. Previous experience designing or developing distributed systems. Practical experience using AI-assisted software development tools for code generation, analysis, and code reviews. Experience developing software for macOS and/or Linux environments. Familiarity with software development lifecycle tools such as Jira, GitHub, and Jenkins is an advantage. Experience with reactive programming, AWS cloud infrastructure, or open-source software contributions is a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work through complex technical challenges. Effective communication and collaboration skills across technical and cross-functional teams. Professional fluency in English, including business-level written, spoken, and reading proficiency. Ability to work from the Pune office three days per week. Benefits Opportunity to work on enterprise SaaS products serving complex technology and business environments. Hybrid work model based in Pune, with three days per week onsite. Exposure to modern software engineering practices, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and AI-assisted development. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8492d16c-8620-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Financial Systems Analyst based in United States. This is a high-impact, fully remote opportunity for an experienced financial systems professional specializing in Workday Financials and Grants Management. You will help optimize financial and sponsored research processes within a complex, grant-funded environment. The role combines functional leadership, systems optimization, reporting, analytics, and continuous process improvement. You will partner closely with Finance, Accounting, Research Administration, Grant and Contract Services, and technical teams. Your work will help strengthen compliance, improve data quality, and make financial information more actionable for decision-makers. The position offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to influence enterprise systems, workflows, and user experience. It is well suited to a collaborative problem-solver who enjoys translating complex operational needs into practical technology solutions. Serve as a functional lead for Workday Financials and Workday Grants Management, advising Finance, Accounting, Grant and Contract Services, and Research Administration stakeholders. Design, configure, optimize, and govern financial and grants-related processes in alignment with Workday best practices, institutional policies, sponsor requirements, and regulatory standards. Support the sponsored research lifecycle, including award setup, budgeting, amendments, cost sharing, facilities and administrative costs, billing, revenue recognition, and closeout. Support core financial processes across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Procurement, Assets, Cash Management, Financial Planning and Analysis, and financial reporting. Lead requirements gathering, business process mapping, gap analysis, and future-state design for financial and grants workflows. Translate complex business requirements into clear functional specifications, system configurations, and scalable solutions. Coordinate system testing, user acceptance testing, issue resolution, implementations, enhancements, and optimization initiatives. Develop and maintain Workday Financials and Grants reports, including standard, custom, and composite reports, dashboards, metrics, and ad hoc analyses. Establish reporting standards, data governance practices, and analytics priorities that support financial management, research oversight, audit readiness, and leadership decision-making. Partner with technical teams to support integrations between Workday and other institutional systems. Provide ongoing functional support, training, documentation, user guides, and process materials to the broader Workday user community. Identify opportunities to improve system usability, productivity, reporting efficiency, data accessibility, and overall user experience. Support internal and external audits, compliance reviews, and sponsor inquiries while maintaining strong data integrity and controls. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an advanced degree such as an MBA is a plus. At least 7 years of progressively responsible experience supporting financial systems. At least 5 years of hands-on experience with Workday Financial Management, including implementation, configuration, administration, and ongoing support. Demonstrated experience with Workday Grants Management and sponsored research processes, preferably within higher education, research, or another grant-funded environment. Strong experience developing Workday Financials and Grants reports, including custom and composite reporting. Proven ability to gather requirements, conduct gap analyses, map business processes, and design effective system solutions. Strong understanding of financial operations, including accounting, financial reporting, procurement, accounts payable and receiv

roadrunnerstudios-roadrunner-studios:lev.title: Executive/Founder in Residence - Advanced Energy
roadrunnerstudios-roadrunner-studios:lev.description: About Roadrunner Venture Studios Roadrunner Venture Studios is the nation’s leading platform for founding breakthrough ventures in deep technology. Our mission is to turn frontier tech into breakthrough companies for the benefit of the American people. Together with engineers, scientists, and entrepreneurs, we build products, create business models, recruit teams, align companies with their first customers, and provide initial funding. Our Venture Studio focuses on advanced energy, advanced materials, advanced manufacturing, and next generation compute. About the Role Roadrunner Venture Studios is seeking an Executive/Founder in Residence (EIR/FIR), Advanced Energy to help identify, shape, and launch new companies at the intersection of energy infrastructure, power generation, and rapidly growing electricity demand. This role is designed for an experienced energy executive who understands not only how power is generated, but how energy projects are financed, contracted, sold, and ultimately turned into bankable businesses. The EIR/FIR will work alongside the Roadrunner team and prospective founders to evaluate new venture opportunities, develop commercial and financing strategies, and help move the strongest concepts from thesis to execution. A particular focus will be opportunities created by hyperscalers, data centers, advanced manufacturing, and other large-load customers whose demand for reliable power is reshaping energy markets. What You'll Do Develop New Energy Ventures: Identify and evaluate opportunities across power generation, energy infrastructure, grid services, and large-load energy markets. Lead Project Finance Strategy: Build and evaluate financing structures for capital-intensive energy projects, including project-level debt and equity, tax incentives, development capital, and other sources of infrastructure financing. Structure Power Offtake: Develop commercial models for selling power through Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), utility contracts, direct-to-customer agreements, and wholesale electricity markets. Engage Hyperscalers & Large Energy Buyers: Build relationships with hyperscalers, data center operators, industrial customers, utilities, and other major power purchasers and understand how they evaluate generation, reliability, price, location, and time-to-power. Build Bankable Projects: Translate technologies and development concepts into projects capable of attracting customers, investors, lenders, and strategic partners. Understand the Economics of Power: Develop and pressure-test revenue models based on the economics of generating and selling electricity, including contracted and merchant power, capacity, ancillary services, and other potential revenue streams. Navigate Grid & Market Dynamics: Evaluate interconnection, transmission, congestion, curtailment, market pricing, and other factors that determine whether and how a project can economically sell power to the grid. Shape Commercial Strategy: Determine where a venture should sit in the value chain—from technology provider to developer, owner/operator, or independent power producer—and how it should ultimately make money. Build the Ecosystem: Develop relationships with utilities, developers, IPPs, infrastructure investors, lenders, hyperscalers, equipment providers, regulators, and other partners necessary to launch and scale new ventures. Support Company Formation: Work directly with Roadrunner and founding teams on business models, financial models, customer development, capital strategy, partnerships, and early company formation. What We're Looking For Significant experience in energy project development, project finance, infrastructure investing, power markets, or commercial energy strategy. Direct experience developing, financing, owning, operating, or transacting around power generation or energy infrastructure projects. Deep understanding of PPAs and other power offtake structures, including the commercial terms that make projects financ

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment isnot a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Commissions are paid every pay period - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek high-energy personalities that thrive in a fast-paced environment to provide a welcoming atmosphere for our Unlimited Wash Pass Members and a memorable first impression on our new car wash guests. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated and have an outgoing, friendly personality. All we ask is for you to share our passion for washing cars, creating memorable moments, and our obsession with exceptional guest service! Location: Russell Speeders Car Wash (Omaha 9) 6003 Center Street, Omaha, NE 68106
